title: AI in warfare: boon or threat?
summary: Drones, autonomous weapons and AI-assisted decisions are changing war. Points for the GD.
body: Artificial intelligence is already used in surveillance, target recognition, logistics, cyber defence and drone swarms. Debate centres on how much decision-making should be left to machines.
AI should support human decisions, not replace them where lives are at stake. India needs its own capability, strict human control over the use of force, and a voice in global rules.
pros: Faster analysis of surveillance data and early warning
Fewer soldiers exposed to danger in mine clearance and reconnaissance
Better maintenance and logistics through prediction
cons: Risk of autonomous weapons killing without human judgement
Errors, bias or hacking can cause unintended escalation
An arms race in AI between major powers
Accountability is unclear when a machine makes a mistake
